chemistry-h1-q1.s.s1.prompt: Wane sakamakon gwaji ne ya fi daidai wajen kwatanta ikon gudanar da wutar lantarki na abu A (sodium chloride) da abu B (sukari)?

chemistry-h1-q5.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
chemistry-h1-q5.material: Mene ne sunan matsalar muhalli inda sulfur dioxide (SO₂) ko nitrogen oxides (NOx) da ake fitarwa daga ƙona man burbushin halittu ke amsawa da tururin ruwa a sararin samaniya su samar da sulfuric acid ko nitric acid kuma su rage pH na ruwan sama ƙasa da na al'ada (kusan 5.6)?
chemistry-h1-q5.s.s1.prompt: Mene ne sunan matsalar muhalli inda sulfur dioxide (SO₂) ko nitrogen oxides (NOx) da ake fitarwa daga ƙona man burbushin halittu ke amsawa da tururin ruwa a sararin samaniya su samar da sulfuric acid ko nitric acid kuma su rage pH na ruwan sama ƙasa da na al'ada (kusan 5.6)?
chemistry-h1-q5.s.s1.explain: Sulfur oxides da nitrogen oxides suna amsawa da ruwa a sararin samaniya su samar da acid masu ƙarfi, sulfuric acid ($\text{H}_2\text{SO}_4$) da nitric acid ($\text{HNO}_3$), don haka ruwan sama mai ƙarfin acid mai $\text{pH} < 5.6$ yana sauka yana maida ƙasa da tabkuna acidic.

chemistry-killer-10.title: Mai zuwa shi ne
chemistry-killer-10.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
chemistry-killer-10.material:
Mai zuwa shi ne ma'aunin haɗa ammonia. $\mathrm{N_2(g) + 3H_2(g) \rightleftharpoons 2NH_3(g)}$, $\Delta H < 0$ (amsawar fitar zafi). A cikin kwantena mai rufi a zafi tsayayye wanda ya kai equilibrium, an canza yanayi kowanne daban kuma an kai sabon equilibrium.
(I) A rage girman kwantena yayin da zafi ke tsayayye.
(II) A ƙara zafi yayin da girma ke tsayayye.
(III) A ƙara Ar(g) wanda ba ya amsawa yayin da zafi da girma ke tsayayye.
(IV) A ƙara Ar(g) yayin da zafi da (jimillar) matsin lamba ke tsayayye kuma girma ya ƙaru.
(V) A ƙara $\mathrm{H_2(g)}$ yayin da zafi da girma ke tsayayye.
Waɗanne yanayi ne kaɗai ke sa mole (mol) na $\mathrm{NH_3}$ a sabon equilibrium ya fi na equilibrium na asali?
chemistry-killer-10.s.s1.prompt:
Mai zuwa shi ne ma'aunin haɗa ammonia. $\mathrm{N_2(g) + 3H_2(g) \rightleftharpoons 2NH_3(g)}$, $\Delta H < 0$ (amsawar fitar zafi). A cikin kwantena mai rufi a zafi tsayayye wanda ya kai equilibrium, an canza yanayi kowanne daban kuma an kai sabon equilibrium.
(I) A rage girman kwantena yayin da zafi ke tsayayye.
(II) A ƙara zafi yayin da girma ke tsayayye.
(III) A ƙara Ar(g) wanda ba ya amsawa yayin da zafi da girma ke tsayayye.
(IV) A ƙara Ar(g) yayin da zafi da (jimillar) matsin lamba ke tsayayye kuma girma ya ƙaru.
(V) A ƙara $\mathrm{H_2(g)}$ yayin da zafi da girma ke tsayayye.
Waɗanne yanayi ne kaɗai ke sa mole (mol) na $\mathrm{NH_3}$ a sabon equilibrium ya fi na equilibrium na asali?
chemistry-killer-10.s.s1.explain:
Mataki na 1: Mole na iskar gas masu amsawa 4 → samfura 2 mol. Amsawar gaba tana fitar da zafi.
Mataki na 2: (I) Rage girma = ƙara matsin lamba → equilibrium yana komawa amsawar gaba da ke rage mole na gas → NH3 yana ƙaruwa.
(II) Ƙara zafi → hanyar shan zafi, wato amsawar baya → NH3 yana raguwa.
(III) A girma tsayayye, ƙara Ar ba ya canza ƙarfi (matsin kowane gas) na N2, H2 da NH3, don haka Q = K ya tsaya → babu motsi, NH3 ba ya canzawa.
(IV) A matsin lamba tsayayye, ƙara Ar yana ƙara girma kuma duk ƙarfin iskar gas masu amsawa yana raguwa → motsi zuwa amsawar baya da ke ƙara mole na gas → NH3 yana raguwa.
(V) Ƙara $\mathrm{H_2}$ → Q < K → amsawar gaba → ɓangare na H2 ya ƙare kuma NH3 yana ƙaruwa (mole na NH3 yana ƙaruwa).
Mataki na 3: Yanayin da NH3 ke ƙaruwa: (I), (V).
Amsa: (I), (V) (b).

chemistry-killer-10.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
